御三家錦鯉 · Gosanke Koi

Concept inspiration: https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks
and https://github.com/poplolioi11/yunlong
The fish geometry, pigment patterns, water and shared renderer are newly implemented.
No fish photographs are distributed. Project copyright: 2026 Chen-Yu Chu (曲宸宇).
